text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon.
Heading to the cafeteria for a meal...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*CLATTER!*)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Nwaaaaagh~~?!
My teacup has cracked again, aaaaagh?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
C-Calm down.
It can still hold tea as a cup. See?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
However, this makes five times already!
This goes far beyond mere tea party etiquette!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Guhhhh~~...
At this rate... at this rate...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Having an elegant teatime with King-san
shall remain a pipe dream forever, aaaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Come on, everyone starts out like that.
I used to break them all the time back then, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'd stain my skirt and cry, and Ryan and the others
would comfort me... fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
See? So let's give it another shot.
I'll stay with you and teach you until you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The feeling of wanting to get closer to someone you look up to...
I understand that very well, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Dober-san...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! Please drill the art of etiquette
right into this thick skull of mine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro Dober's tea party etiquette lessons
continued, however...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*CRUNCH!!*)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaaaagh~~?!
The scone has been pulverized to dust~~?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-It's fine, it's fine!
Let's save the sweets for later and practice pouring the tea next—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*SNAP!!*)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaagh?! The teapot handle snapped clean off?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
F-For now, I'll borrow some adhesive!
Once we fix it, let's try once more—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet, despite both their struggles, time marched on in vain...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Guhhhhh~~...
To think night has fallen and I still cannot even pour a cup of tea!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Curse it... I curse this hand...
Trained never to let go of Prince Charming, this—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I curse this Princess Right Hand of mine!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's proof of how hard you worked for your dream.
You don't have to hate it. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Didn't *a certain someone* say
that the most important thing is "moving forward"?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What matters most is the passion of "wanting to become someone."
Moving forward toward one's ideal self!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
When brought to a halt,
we must break through with sheer spirit and guts, just like with that boulder earlier!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Isn't it time to show off the true guts of a princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You certainly got me there.
If you put it that way—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: DOHHHHH-SEIIIYYYAAAAGH!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...And just like that, I shall smash right through this wall♪
Just like Dober-san did back then!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, without delay! To recall that feeling,
I shall go pulverize a punching bag to pieces!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Just like I did back then, huh?
I see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not about changing.
Back then, I had already "changed."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Kawakami made me realize it again.
I have to repay her properly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Feeling her own growth, Mejiro Dober chased after Kawakami Princess.
